turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to figure out where I should study this semester.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is my bedroom desk, which is quiet but right next to my bed and my phone charger.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the campus library, a twenty minute walk, but nobody bothers me there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's the coffee shop downstairs, a bit noisy, but I always feel weirdly focused there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do you get distracted more by noise or by your phone? If it's the phone, the library is the clear winner. The coffee shop could work for lighter tasks like reviewing.
